title: 2.1.3 Applications of AI
description: Real-world applications of artificial intelligence in commerce, autonomous transit, surveillance, farming, healthcare, space, and banking from Grade 11 ICT Section 2.1.2.

questions.question: How do online shopping platforms utilize AI to enhance customer experience?
options: By processing user data to deliver personalized product suggestions
By eliminating warehouse storage fees for international vendors
By replacing cargo container ships with autonomous drones
By computing manual sales tax receipts on physical registers
questions.correctAnswer: By processing user data to deliver personalized product suggestions

questions.question: Which trio of data sources enables autonomous vehicles to operate without human intervention?
options: GPS, vehicle radar, and optical cameras
Barometers, thermometers, and compasses
Radio receivers, speedometers, and dynamos
Pneumatic gauges, odometers, and whistles
questions.correctAnswer: GPS, vehicle radar, and optical cameras

questions.question: Which manufacturer is cited as a pioneer of production vehicle autopilot systems?
options: Tesla
Toyota
Nissan
Ford

questions.question: Which features enable autonomous cars to significantly enhance road safety?
options: Exchanging hazard data and maintaining 360-degree environmental awareness
Operating at unlimited travel speeds in dense urban pedestrian zones
Overriding municipal traffic lights during peak commute travel hours
Consuming aviation kerosene to accelerate engine combustion ratios
questions.correctAnswer: Exchanging hazard data and maintaining 360-degree environmental awareness

questions.question: Why has artificial intelligence become indispensable for modern social media companies?
options: The volume of user content is too vast for human moderation
Social media platforms operate without connected server infrastructure
Telecommunications laws require automated accounts on every website
Web browsers refuse to display manual status posts without AI
questions.correctAnswer: The volume of user content is too vast for human moderation

questions.question: Which social networking corporation is cited as applying AI for advertising and facial recognition?
options: Facebook
LinkedIn
Pinterest
Snapchat

questions.question: What is the primary role of AI in security and retail surveillance?
options: Detecting suspicious behaviors automatically in real time
Turning off security cameras during scheduled office hours
Recording camera feeds exclusively onto magnetic audio tapes
Restricting building access based on paper invitation cards
questions.correctAnswer: Detecting suspicious behaviors automatically in real time

questions.question: Which agricultural techniques are directly driven by artificial intelligence systems?
options: Precision farming, pest detection, and crop health tracking
Manual sickle harvesting, ox plowing, and flood irrigation
Total deforestation, slash-and-burn clearing, and wood burning
Replacing grain agriculture with synthetic laboratory pellets
questions.correctAnswer: Precision farming, pest detection, and crop health tracking

questions.question: How are agricultural advisory systems beneficial to modern farmers?
options: They assist farmers in becoming climate-ready and adapting activities
They guarantee fixed international grain prices before seed planting
They eliminate the biological need for sunlight in outdoor crops
They automate the legal registration of ancestral rural land deeds
questions.correctAnswer: They assist farmers in becoming climate-ready and adapting activities

questions.question: What is a chatbot in modern business customer support?
options: A system simulating conversation through text or voice commands
A robotic hardware arm packaging parcels along factory belts
An automated teller machine dispensing bank paper currency
A network router directing data packets between subnets
questions.correctAnswer: A system simulating conversation through text or voice commands

questions.question: What primary operational benefit do customer service chatbots provide to businesses?
options: Fast and cost-effective customer assistance around the clock
Elimination of computer server electricity consumption
Immediate legal verification of client identity passports
Automatic manufacturing of custom replacement electronic goods
questions.correctAnswer: Fast and cost-effective customer assistance around the clock

questions.question: In healthcare, which complex medical procedures benefit from AI assistance?
options: Disease diagnosis, drug discovery, and surgical operations
Hospital bed construction, cafeteria catering, and laundering
Emergency ambulance tire replacement and chassis alignment
Printing paper medical charts and physical prescription pads
questions.correctAnswer: Disease diagnosis, drug discovery, and surgical operations

questions.question: What is the name of the NASA humanoid robot stationed on the International Space Station?
options: Robonaut
Curiosity
Pathfinder
Perseverance

questions.question: What operational capacity does Robonaut have on the International Space Station?
options: Uses astronaut tools to execute tasks normally performed by humans
Acts as the orbital rocket booster for station orbital adjustments
Generates oxygen supplies by electrolyzing onboard wastewater tanks
Maintains commercial telecommunications billing with ground stations
questions.correctAnswer: Uses astronaut tools to execute tasks normally performed by humans

questions.question: Which everyday household capabilities are managed by AI systems in smart homes?
options: Home surveillance, automated chores, and fire smoke alerting
Eliminating utility water pipes and indoor wiring infrastructure
Converting municipal tap water directly into organic fruit juice
Printing currency banknotes to pay monthly utility invoices
questions.correctAnswer: Home surveillance, automated chores, and fire smoke alerting

questions.question: How do commercial banks use artificial intelligence for security protection?
options: By tracing credit card transaction patterns to flag anomalies
By locking bank entry doors during normal morning business hours
By enforcing manual wax seals on customer monthly statements
By storing account balances on mechanical typewriter sheets
questions.correctAnswer: By tracing credit card transaction patterns to flag anomalies
